fusions.name: Folding Shut
fusions.desc: You fold your wings shut around one enemy, dealing 16 dark damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sealed-Room Shriek
fusions.desc: Sends a shriek into the first enemy in its path for 16 resonating damage, using up every affliction you have on it for 60% more damage per affliction, and leaves it [Inescapable] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Curtain of Wings
fusions.desc: Hangs a curtain of bats 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it, and anything that touches it moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Captive Larder
fusions.desc: Anything you strike moves 15% slower for 2 seconds. When you afflict an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds; once every 8 seconds.
